title: CHAI RAVE LA: DIWALI AT SUNSET @ LEVEL8 ON NOV 6TH. SPECIAL DIWALI EDITION!
description: Celebrate Diwali above LA with sunset views, music, dancing, cocktails, food and Chai Rave energy—all on a stunning rooftop.

CHAI RAVE presents...

DIWALI AT SUNSET
For one night only, Chai Rave transforms the rooftop into a glowing Diwali escape at sunset.

Expect the pool deck to come alive with floating diyas, warm candlelight, marigold-inspired décor, shimmering reflections across the water, rich festive colors, and photo-worthy installations designed to completely transform the space as day turns into night.

Come early for golden hour, stay for the lights.

As the sun sets over Los Angeles, the rooftop shifts into a full Diwali celebration with music, dancing, cocktails, Indo-Western fashion, and Chai Rave energy carrying into the night.

☀️ THE EXPERIENCE✨ South Asian Vendors
✨Complimentary goodies
✨ Diwali light ceremony
✨ Goldenhour into Sunset
✨ Poolside cabanas
✨ Henna station & much more

👗 ATTIRE: INDO-WESTERNCome dressed in your best Indo-Western fits — where South Asian style meets modern fashion.
Think lehenga skirts with crop tops, sarees with statement blouses, kurtas with sneakers, embroidered jackets, draped silhouettes, fusion sets, bold accessories, and elevated resort/nightlife looks.
Traditional is welcome. Contemporary is welcome. Make it your own.

☀️ ROOFTOP. POOLSIDE. FULL TAKEOVER.Dance beneath the LA sun, grab a cocktail at the iconic golden carousel bar, relax inside a poolside cabana, and take in incredible panoramic views of the Los Angeles skyline.

Expect elevated beach and pool vibes, immersive production, beautiful photo moments, and nonstop energy from beginning to end.

The venue alone is going to be an immpecable experience—and we’re bringing the full Chai Rave energy with us.
